idea: Re-evaluate the async-events-design 5-option matrix in light of codex-channels-option-b ship (c3075b6c, 2026-06-02). Assess adjacent tasks 3d-workers and agent-comms; answer codex-as-crews-engine question. Research + design only.

candidateDirections.name: Long-poll / explicit-seam v0 before channels-first producers
candidateDirections.summary: Ship producer logic as a long-poll async_events_wait MCP tool (and/or extend codex app-server fs_watch for U4) first; channels-first push is a fast-follow that reuses the same producer code.

candidateDirections.name: Durable mailbox + channel wake (agent-comms B/C + codex-as-crews)
candidateDirections.summary: Mailbox stays source of truth; channel notifications carry 'you have mail' wake signals; missed wakes recoverable via mailbox re-read. Single pattern resolves agent-comms Scopes B+C and the codex-as-crews-engine question.

candidateDirections.name: Channels-first Node producer hub
candidateDirections.summary: Extend packages/happy-cli/src/codex/happyMcpStdioBridge.ts with git/fs/timer producers emitting standard MCP notifications now that the consumer exists. Smallest visible-result increment for U1/U2/U4.

candidateDirections.name: Delay producer build-out — run a pilot first
candidateDirections.summary: Run a measurement pilot (routing enabled, synthetic producers, multi-session) before committing producer-ecosystem investment. Direct counter to D-003.

questionsForSynthesis: Which event kinds truly require in-session reaction instead of exit-and-respawn?
Is the authority of record for each use case the MCP producer (D-003), the app-server (D-001 fs_watch hint), or a durable mailbox/store (D-002)?
Can routing become per-subscription/per-session before multi-session producers ship, or is global per-server/per-kind policy acceptable for v1?
What is the explicit missed-wake recovery path when routing is disabled, the session is mid-turn, or the app-server idles out?
Should agent-comms be rescoped now to unblock Scope B+C while keeping Scope A explicitly blocked?
For codex-as-crews-engine: is anyone proposing to move message durability OUT of the file mailbox, or are we explicitly settling on mailbox=source-of-truth + channels=wake-hint?
